_doc: Rules of the shell extractor (keys: see ts_generic.rules_of). scan_before: the string argument of a command is script text only right after `-c` (or a bundle of options ending in c, `-lc`) of a shell (sh, bash, zsh, dash, ksh, ash; `grep -c "x"` is no script): `bash -c 'check_item "$1"'` calls the function check_item. roots main-toplevel: a command at the top level of a file that is not a shell option, an include or a trap is a statement of a script (soft main on the file): the functions that the statements call are used, a file that only defines functions is a library and gets no root. dyn.name: a command word that starts with literal text and goes on with an expansion (`"check_$t"`, `check_${t}`) is the dynamic site name:<prefix>*, every function whose name starts with the prefix may be the one that runs (D); a prefix shorter than 3 characters or with a character that no function name has (a path) makes no site.
